item.title: Show HN: Mini DBA – monitoring for on prem and cloud databases in 1 place
item.summary: Mini DBA is a monitoring tool for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and Oracle, including managed cloud databases on AWS and Azure. It provides live activity, performance analysis, alerts and history with a tasteful amount of AI to help out. Free community edition. Try the live demo: https://demo.minidba.com/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49390319 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
